title: Reality Merge
introTitle: Two views of one building. They do not agree yet.
introBody: The blue plan and the teal survey point cloud use different placement. Move and rotate the survey against all three site controls. Only then compare the planned and existing opening.
registerHelp: Drag the teal reality layer to move it. Drag its amber ring to rotate. Bring all three matching controls together; one matching corner is not enough.
compareHelp: The anchors have converged. Sweep the clip and adjust opacity to compare the planned opening with the survey. Click the genuine shifted opening in the viewport.
solvedHelp: The outer edges agree after registration. The existing opening is in a different position from the plan. Record it for review; alignment alone could not explain this difference.
anchorsNotReady: Align all three controls to unlock comparison
keyboard: Keyboard: focus the viewport; arrows move, Q/E rotate. Pointer: drag the teal layer or amber rotation ring.
feedback.lock: Registration locked. The false offsets have disappeared. Now inspect the fine survey detail.
feedback.false: That mark is explained by aligned geometry or representation detail. Sweep the opening area again.
feedback.found: You identified a genuine opening-position difference after aligning the references.
inspectHint: Click the survey opening after comparing layers
snapHint: The survey will lock when all three controls are close enough.
